verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA above the headline, so the reading order is backwards. Its three badges are shrunk to illegible slivers and the SOLSTICE logo is reduced to a tiny mark under an oversized can. A broken 'missing asset' placeholder sits at the top, and the headline runs almost edge to edge. B keeps the logical order (brand, then headline, body copy, CTA) with readable badges and a strong headline. However, its 'SUNSET SALE' tag is crammed against the Award badge, the logo and can are scattered small in the top corners, and the 'missing asset' placeholder collides with the legal text at the bottom right.
